test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following questions, a statement has been given with highlighted text. Select the options that can replace the text with the correct idiom or phrase.

The new music system is** too expensive** for us to buy

options.text: Costs an arm and a leg

solution:
The correct answer is Costs an arm and a leg.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's check each option:
 
 
• Cut to the chase: come to the point.

 
 
• *Example: cut to the chase—what is it you want us to do?*
 
 
 
• Hit the books: to study hard; cram
 
 
• *Example: I have to hit the books this weekend — I have two exams next week.*
 
 
 
• *Costs an arm and a leg: very **expensive***
 
 
• *Example: A week at a health farm can cost an arm and a leg.*
 
 
 
• At sea: to be confused; to be lost and bewildered
 
 
• *Example: I'm all/completely at sea with the new computer system*
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct **idiom** to replace the highlighted text is Costs an arm and a leg.​
